title: Certificate of Approximate Punctuality
subject: HABITUAL LATENESS
citation: for arriving at 9:14 every morning with the consistency of a scheduled service, and for a different and compelling reason each time.

title: Certificate of Meetings That Were Emails
subject: THIRTY MINUTES
citation: for convening nine people to communicate a single sentence that would have survived transmission in written form.

title: Certificate of Permanent Audio Only
subject: CAMERA STATUS: OFF
citation: for two years of attendance confirmed by voice alone, and for connection difficulties of remarkable and consistent specificity.

title: Certificate of Delayed Unmuting
subject: YOU'RE ON MUTE
citation: for delivering the first four seconds of every observation directly into a muted microphone. Without fail. Without learning.

title: Certificate of Reply All
subject: DISTRIBUTION: EVERYONE
citation: for informing four hundred colleagues of a lunch preference, and for the subsequent apology, sent by the same method.

title: Certificate of Caffeine Dependency
subject: SUSTAINED INTAKE
citation: for a personality that does not commence until the second cup, and for treating the office machine as a life support system.

title: Certificate of Snack Provision
subject: UNPAID, UNPROMPTED
citation: for the unexplained appearance of pastries on difficult mornings, funded personally, and never once mentioned by the provider.

title: Certificate of Refrigerator Archaeology
subject: CONTENTS UNIDENTIFIED
citation: for a container of considerable age bearing a date that no longer holds meaning, and for the bravery of whoever finally removed it.

title: Certificate of Printer Diplomacy
subject: MECHANICAL WHISPERER
citation: for restoring function to a device that responds to no one else, by means that have never been successfully documented.

title: Certificate of Advanced Jargon
subject: SYNERGY ACHIEVED
citation: for leveraging bandwidth, touching base offline, and taking it away as an action item — all within a single unbroken sentence.

title: Certificate of Spreadsheet Sorcery
subject: PIVOT TABLE CLASS
citation: for a workbook that runs the department, that exactly one person understands, and that must never be opened on a Friday.

title: Certificate of Passive Aggression
subject: KITCHEN CORRESPONDENCE
citation: for notices affixed to the microwave in a tone of steadily escalating politeness, signed only: The Team.

title: Certificate of Crisis Response
subject: FIRST ON SCENE
citation: for solving, at 4:55pm on a Friday, a problem that had been raised, ignored, and raised again since Tuesday morning.

title: Certificate of Minutes Taken
subject: SOLE WITNESS
citation: for maintaining the only written record of what was actually agreed, and for producing it whenever anyone claims otherwise.

title: Certificate of Calendar Tetris
subject: FULLY BOOKED
citation: for a calendar so densely packed that lunch now appears as a recurring conflict, automatically declined.

title: Certificate of Successful Onboarding
subject: PROBATION SURVIVED
citation: for learning the passwords, the acronyms, and which printer to avoid — in that order, over the course of nine months.

title: Certificate of Extended Service
subject: STILL HERE
citation: for outlasting four managers, three restructures and two relocations, without displaying a visible reaction to any of them.

title: Certificate of Unrequested Availability
subject: SENT 23:47, SUNDAY
citation: for correspondence timestamped at hours suggesting either exceptional dedication or a situation that should be discussed.

title: Certificate of Percussive Typing
subject: AUDIBLE FROM RECEPTION
citation: for a keyboard technique that conveys tremendous urgency to the entire floor, regardless of what is being written.

title: Certificate of the Final Question
subject: ASKED AT 4:58PM
citation: for raising, in the closing two minutes, the one consideration that adds forty minutes and cannot reasonably be dismissed.

title: Certificate of Botanical Stewardship
subject: SOLE SURVIVOR
citation: for the continued survival of the one plant, watered by one person, in an environment engineered entirely against it.

title: Certificate of Interpretive Dress Code
subject: BUSINESS ADJACENT
citation: for an interpretation of business casual that has never been formally challenged, and at this point never will be.
